capabilities.title: Project understanding and debugging
capabilities.body: Look at your project's setup and explain errors in plain language, so you know where a problem comes from.

capabilities.title: Code safety and recovery
capabilities.body: Back up before changes, review every change file by file, and undo what you don't want to keep.

capabilities.title: Integrations with tools you use
capabilities.body: Bring context from services such as GitHub, deployment platforms and design tools into one place, read-only first.

capabilities.title: AI-assisted coding workflows
capabilities.body: Prepare clear, structured briefs for the AI coding tool you already use, with secrets removed.

capabilities.title: Task automation
capabilities.body: Automate repetitive project chores, such as running checks, with you approving anything sensitive.

capabilities.title: Scheduled automations you choose
capabilities.body: Pick which automations run, and when. Nothing runs on a schedule you didn't set.

capabilities.title: Workflow management
capabilities.body: Keep track of what you're building, what broke and what's next, across projects.

capabilities.title: Music and everyday integrations
capabilities.body: Useful extras for long build sessions, such as music. An idea we are exploring, not a commitment.

steps.title: Connect your project and tools
steps.body: Choose a project folder and, if you want, connect services you already use. Connections start read-only.

steps.title: Understand what's happening
steps.body: See your project's setup, recent changes and errors explained in plain language.

steps.title: Automate, and stay in control
steps.body: Pick the tasks to automate and when they run. You approve anything that changes files or services. Review every change, keep backups and undo what you don't want. Your own AI tool does the coding.

principles.title: You approve sensitive actions
principles.body: The design requires your explicit approval before anything changes files or acts on a connected service.

principles.title: Honest status
principles.body: We label everything as working, in development, planned or exploring. Nothing on this site is a launch promise.

principles.title: Works with your AI tools
principles.body: It is designed to sit alongside Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools, not to replace them.

principles.title: Credentials stay server-side
principles.body: The architecture keeps service credentials encrypted on a backend, never inside the desktop app.

status.working: An early development foundation: a local backend, an integration platform and a read-only GitHub connection, tested by the developer with automated tests against a simulated GitHub API. Not a public release.
status.planned: Project understanding, debugging help, code safety and recovery, automations, scheduled automations, workflow management and more integrations.
status.undecided: The release date, pricing, the website domain and the final list of integrations.

hero.eyebrow: For vibe coders · In early development
hero.headline: Your ideas deserve more than just AI.
hero.lead: VibeHeal is an intelligent assistant for the projects you build with AI tools. It is designed to help you understand what is happening, connect the tools you already use and keep control of every change. It is in early development and not available yet.
